decisions.reason: The fifteen-day program draws on existing production and logistics know-how, and its delivery results are easy to read, though it remains a candidate for being folded into the umbrella express line D.

The 72-hour program fits the firm's fast-response strategy and builds on its spare-parts and manufacturing logistics, but it is operationally demanding and only mentioned on the website, so the risk of consolidation stays elevated.
The European-approved exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular fire-door system and sits squarely within the firm's in-house R&D and certification expertise.
This multi-model express line has its own page and serves as the umbrella for the firm's fast-delivery offering, drawing on core production and logistics competencies.
The fire and smoke protection door rests on certified core competencies and in-house engineering, and products of this kind are typically kept for the long term.
